 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=g[0][0]
    fg=next(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=bg)
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]!=bg: continue
            # Within any contiguous stroke, fill all missing cells in the span
            # with marker color 2; spans require endpoints in figure color.
            if c>0 and c<w-1 and grid[r][c-1]==fg and grid[r][c+1]==fg:
                g[r][c]=2
            if r>0 and r<h-1 and grid[r-1][c]==fg and grid[r+1][c]==fg:
                g[r][c]=2
    # Also extrapolate lone breaks along horizontal top/bottom strokes: a gap
    # is identified by same-row color on either side, handled above.
    return g

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pass
# Recolors one-cell interruptions of the main colored strokes as 2.
